findings.evidence: PRE-EXISTING, NOT CAUSED BY THIS BRANCH — see scope proof below. Wave A spec (tests/Playwright/test-e2e-A-2026-09-01.spec.js:284) failed: cart at state 04 rendered line 'Sauce supplementaire | Ketchup | 1,00 EUR' with 'Sous-total 1,00 EUR / Total 1,00 EUR', but the SAME order (scoped by the id returned by POST /admin/pos, never assumed to be the first row) shows '0,50 EUR' in the a-encaisser queue. Backend is authoritative and agrees with the queue: order id=3 total=0.500000, subtotal=0.500000, delivery_charge=0.000000, one order_item item_id=4 qty=1 price=0.500000. Catalog data: Item 4 'Sauce supplementaire' price=0.500000; its chosen variation 'Ketchup' price=0.000000 under attribute 'Sauce (1ere Gratuite)'. So 0,50 EUR is the correct price and the CART DISPLAY doubled the item's own unit price (2 x 0,50), it did not add the sauce (the sauce is genuinely 0.00). Operational impact: the cashier reads 1,00 EUR on screen and would quote that to the customer, while the system creates and will collect 0,50 EUR. Quoted price != charged price. Corroborated independently in an unrelated capture: test-e2e-B/02-voice-assistant-disabled-state.png shows the same order in the queue as 'N0A0032 Tel 0,50 EUR'.
